svg.title: Two viral loop options for YouTube media comment extension
svg.desc: Option 1 uses domain URLs which get filtered by YouTube. Option 2 uses custom text syntax with a curiosity-gap mechanism. A recommended hybrid combines Chrome Web Store URL (Google domain, survives filter) with custom syntax.
svg.text: Recommended: hybrid loop using Google's own domain
Installs → becomes extension user → loop continues
Key insight: chromewebstore.google.com is a Google-owned domain and almost
certainly survives YouTube's own URL filter. Test this immediately — it may be your bridge.
